observations.text: An older title value 'Credit Card Demo Application (CCDA)' is kept as a comment above the active CardDemo title.

purpose: Defines CCDA-SCREEN-TITLE, three 40-byte literal texts used as screen header titles across the CardDemo online programs. COACTUPC moves CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 into the TITLE01O and TITLE02O fields of its map in 3100-SCREEN-INIT.
